text: Court is now in session. This is the case of The Missing Cookies.
Your Honour, at lunchtime a whole jar of cookies disappeared from the school kitchen. We will show that Sam was there, and that Sam took them.
Your Honour, Sam was nowhere near that kitchen. He spent his whole lunch in the library, with a book and his own cookies from home.
Accuser, please show your evidence.

Overruled. I see no problem with it. The hallway video stays in.

I do.

I was walking to the playground and I saw Sam go into the kitchen. I'm sure it was him.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. Maya's story stays in.
When a teacher found Sam after lunch, his shirt was covered in cookie crumbs.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The crumbs on Sam's shirt stays in.
Your Honour, I'd like to call my witness, Mrs. Bell, the school cook.
I do.
Mrs. Bell, what were you told?
A student came up to me after lunch and said: it was Sam, Sam took the cookies. I didn't see it myself.
Sustained. A rumour isn't proof. What Mrs. Bell heard is thrown out.
We rest our case.

Court is now in session. This is the case of The Broken Bike.
Your Honour, Ana lent Raj her new bike for one afternoon. It came back with a bent wheel, and she had to pay to fix it. Raj should pay.
Your Honour, that wheel was wobbly before Raj ever touched it. You can't blame him for damage that was already there.
Here's the bike shop receipt. A new wheel cost ninety dollars.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The repair receipt stays in.
That evening, Raj sent Ana this text. It says: sorry, I hit a curb.
Sustained. Nobody has shown it's real. Raj's text is thrown out.
This photo was taken the morning Raj borrowed the bike. Look closely. The wheel is perfectly straight.
I'll allow it. The morning photo is now part of the record.

I do.
Kim, what bent that wheel?

Dr. Fox, you measured the paw prints. What did you find?

Accepted. The vet's opinion counts as evidence.
Mrs. Green has complained about Rex five times before. She may have made up her mind already.
Accepted. The old complaints counts as evidence.

Court is now in session. This is the case of Helix Dynamics Trade-Secret Exfiltration.
Your Honour, at two in the morning someone copied Helix's secret chip design and sent it out. We will show it was Adrian Vance, and that he did it for money.
Your Honour, Adrian was asleep at home. His password was stolen in a phishing attack months ago. Someone used his account. Not him.
Police searched his laptop and found the secret Tessellate design files on it.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The laptop files stays in.
Your Honour, I'd like to call my witness, Dr. Lena Marsh, a computer expert.
I do.
Dr. Marsh, what was in that upload?
The upload was 4.2 gigabytes. The secret Tessellate design archive is 4.2 gigabytes. That is not a coincidence.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. Dr. Marsh's analysis stays in.
The company's login records show Vance's account connecting at nine minutes past two in the morning.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The login record stays in.

Sustained. Both sides must see evidence before the trial. The recruiter emails is thrown out.

I do.
What did he tell you?

Overruled. I see no problem with it. Priya's account stays in.
Twelve days later, forty thousand dollars in crypto landed in his account.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The crypto payment stays in.

Overruled. I see no problem with it. The badge record stays in.

Court is now in session. This is the case of Aurora Protocol Flash-Loan Exploit.
Your Honour, thirty-one million dollars was drained from the Aurora crypto app in minutes. We will show the accused did it and meant to keep it.
Your Honour, my client found a hole in Aurora's code and moved the money to protect it, just like Aurora's own rules invite. Then he gave it back.

Overruled. I see no problem with it. The blockchain records stays in.
Police found the wallet's secret recovery words written on paper in his flat.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The secret key stays in.

Sustained. Nobody has shown it's real. The chat message is thrown out.

Sustained. Both sides must see evidence before the trial. The exchange ID file is thrown out.

I do.
Ms. Ibarra, where did the attacker's money come from?
I followed the money backwards. The attacking wallet was funded straight from an exchange account in the accused's own name.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. Rosa's money trail stays in.
Your Honour, I'd like to call my witness, Kofi Mensah, an Aurora developer.
I do.
Mr. Mensah, is this how friendly hackers behave?

Overruled. I see no problem with it. Kofi's opinion stays in.
Your Honour, they haven't given you real proof that that wallet took the money. Please end the trial now.

Court is now in session. This is the case of AV-7 Crosswalk Collision.
Your Honour, a self-driving taxi hit a cyclist in a crosswalk. The company knew its cars struggle to see bikes at dusk, and shipped them anyway.
Your Honour, our car saw the cyclist and braked. The cyclist rode through a red light. This was a tragic accident, not a faulty car.
Your Honour, I'd like to call my witness, Dr. Ben Hollis, a crash expert.
I do.
Dr. Hollis, when did the car brake?
I rebuilt the crash from the skid marks and video. The car began braking nearly a second later than it should have.
Overruled. I see no problem with it. The crash reconstruction stays in.

Accepted. The medical bills counts as evidence.
